description: Seethawaka Pradeshiya Sabha - Road List of the Seethawaka Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically the declaration of roads belonging to the Seethawaka Pradeshiya Sabha. It contains detailed information about road names, plan numbers, starting/ending points, lengths, and widths - all of which fall under land registrations and property ownership matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
